body: ESTIMATE_PENDING_UNA. MAINLINE-004b range for P2-A, P2-C, P2-K and P2-E. Every factor is QUESTIONABLE. Conservative is the sealed NASA SP-8032 row. Central is 0.20, Wagner, Huehne, Zhang and Tang 2020, doi 10.1016/j.ijpvp.2019.104015: equation 7 equals about 0.2 in the elastic region. Equation 7 was not evaluated. The lower bound 0.21 was not used. The main line carries optimistic knockdown 0.90, Wagner 2020 Table 3 row 12, Krenzke and Kiernan, reliable yes, the highest reliable upper in that table. That range mixes R/t 10-212 and reaches only lambda 33.18. These rows have lambda near 65-68. Adam's reliable upper 0.89 is not the carry. Classical 1.0 is reference only. Sim et al. 2024, doi 10.1155/2024/8765733, give small-scale foam-core factors 0.20 and 0.22, which do not support 0.90. Monocoque curves are transferred with phi = pi and t_eq. Required modulus scales as 1/kd. At 0.90 the buckling SF and required modulus are P2-A 1.038550613 and 66342457592.2 Pa; P2-C 0.878412394393 and 78436962456.1 Pa; P2-K 1.01188911831 and 68090464412.6 Pa; P2-E 1.05248510547 and 65464109318.2 Pa. P2-C is still above the QUESTIONABLE alloy modulus 68.9 GPa. Conservative SFs remain 0.162351930234, 0.137388392766, 0.158259023565, 0.164568553708. NFI-OPT-GAP is the ratio near 6.4. Strength SFs stay at the 003 values. Start 2026-10-19T22:48:41.445118-07:00. End 2026-10-19T22:48:50.520370-07:00. Elapsed 9.075277327094227 s, a measurement. Source reading preceded the stamp. The deadline 2026-10-20T07:00:00-07:00 is a door check-in, not a limit. This report leaves the caps-open order open. 008 is filed. 007 is not, so MAINLINE-009 is not started. NFI-CRUSH is already filed. Una004 is not opened.
